methodology: Preliminary ayah-by-ayah thematic screening only. Earlier passages are unverified research leads, not independently checked in critical editions. Neither direct borrowing nor historical dependence is asserted. No-specific-parallel is provisional.
coverage_ledger_status: batch checkpoint only; reconcile outstanding draft PRs into canonical ledger before merging

entries.summary: In distress people invoke God, who may remove distress
entries.caveat: Deliverance after crying to God; Qur'an challenges the invocation of other gods, unlike psalm's Israelite thanksgiving

entries.summary: Earlier peoples afflicted with hardship to induce humility
entries.caveat: Repeated afflictions and failure to return to God; Amos names Israel, Qur'an generalizes prior communities

entries.summary: Hearts hardened despite affliction; Satan embellished deeds
entries.caveat: Hardness in Pharaoh narrative is comparable but differs in agency, audience and narrative context

entries.summary: Sudden opening of prosperity followed by punishment
entries.caveat: Prosperity and forgetting God compared; Deuteronomy gives covenant warning rather than identical sudden punishment

entries.summary: Wrongdoers cut off and praise to God
entries.caveat: General judgment formula; no distinctive antecedent established

entries.summary: God can remove hearing and sight and seal hearts
entries.caveat: Hearing, seeing and hardened perception share imagery; divine action and rhetorical setting differ

entries.summary: Punishment unexpectedly or openly overtakes wrongdoers
entries.caveat: General warning without identified prior episode

entries.summary: Messengers as bearers of good news and warnings
entries.caveat: Prophetic warning is comparable, but Qur'an additionally foregrounds good news and salvation

entries.summary: Rejecters of signs face punishment for defiance
entries.caveat: No unique textual narrative or legal predecessor established

entries.summary: Messenger disclaims divine treasures, unseen knowledge, angelic nature
entries.caveat: Revelation to a human prophet is only a broad contrast; Numbers does not present the same threefold disclaimer
